verified_prior_findings.recommended_correction: Run the validated deploy workflow only after tests and fix its verify oracle first.
verified_prior_findings.smallest_regression_test: Compare relative path sets and hashes across source, release, and live, including metadata.

verified_prior_findings.title: Historical campaign --help mutation defect is corrected
reproduction_or_source_evidence: All three commands return 0 for --help and 2 for an unknown argument; pre/post hashes of five generated artifacts are identical; 11 tests pass.
verified_prior_findings.recommended_correction: Keep the shared fail-closed CLI contract and end-to-end hash regression.
verified_prior_findings.smallest_regression_test: For every campaign entrypoint assert help=0, unknown=2, and all output hashes unchanged.

rejected_prior_findings.title: Semantic-impact document's UT verifier counts are stale as current-state evidence
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Current verifier twice reports 912 calls, 296 unique, 240 OK, 0 WARN, 0 FAIL, 56 SKIP; document records 908/297/242/0/3/52.
missing_proof: The document may intentionally preserve historical retry3 evidence, but it is not labeled with a current rerun beside the old counts.
rejected_prior_findings.recommended_correction: Add a dated current-state reconciliation without erasing historical provenance.
rejected_prior_findings.smallest_regression_test: Doc check compares embedded verifier metrics to a captured, identity-bound current verifier artifact.

rejected_prior_findings.title: Prior current-failure claim for UniversalTraits is rejected
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Current suite exits 0 with 374 passed and 0 failed, not 371/2.
rejected_prior_findings.recommended_correction: Retain the older 371/2 only as historical evidence and record the current pass separately.
rejected_prior_findings.smallest_regression_test: Run the full suite and parse final pass/fail counters.

rejected_prior_findings.title: Prior current API verifier failure claim is rejected
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Both current reruns exit 0 with FAIL=0; the historical three FAIL values do not describe the current tree.
missing_proof: 56 SKIP remain and are not safety proof.
rejected_prior_findings.recommended_correction: Version verifier evidence by source tree and PZ identity.
rejected_prior_findings.smallest_regression_test: Assert captured tree hashes and all five status counters before accepting a doc metric.

omissions.title: Current UTMods JCodeMunch index is stale and partial for campaign sources
reproduction_or_source_evidence: The handle reports 389 files indexed 2026-07-18 15:31; current campaign files and later edits are absent/stale.
missing_proof: User prohibited index mutation, so current campaign evidence required direct source inspection after the live guide succeeded.
omissions.recommended_correction: Refresh the canonical UTMods handle under a separately authorized single-writer task.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: After refresh, retrieve campaign_cli.py and compare the Munch content hash to disk.

omissions.title: JDoc semantic-doc surface has duplicate equal-root handles and skipped root sections
reproduction_or_source_evidence: The newer canonical handle verifies 1,878 clean sections, 0 drift/missing/errors, and 48 skipped empty/root ranges; repository resolution returned two equal-root candidates.
missing_proof: The root section of the semantic doc is among skipped ranges, although all substantive heading sections were retrieved clean.
omissions.recommended_correction: Retire the unintended duplicate handle and make root/empty skip semantics explicit.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Resolve normalized source_root to exactly one canonical handle and require all substantive sections clean.

omissions.title: Full semantic delta cannot be regenerated from current PZCodebase Git refs
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Current PZCodebase is restored to the baseline manifest/HEAD; the refreshed target exists as preserved experiment artifacts and archives, not a named Git ref. The document does not provide an old-ref/new-ref pair for pz_toolkit compare.
missing_proof: A full replay would be mutating/expensive and was not authorized; preserved exact diff was hash-verified instead.
omissions.recommended_correction: Publish immutable old/new snapshot identities or refs and a read-only replay command.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Given two immutable snapshot roots, regenerate exact summary/diff in temp and compare canonicalized hashes.

omissions.title: Static semantic evidence does not prove Kahlua, UI, callback, or game-runtime safety
reproduction_or_source_evidence: The bundle itself marks runtime, mutation, and index gates not-run; standard Lua mock suites are off-game.
missing_proof: Require relocation, overload/conversion, event timing, UI mouse-consumption, and live smoke fixtures remain unresolved.
omissions.recommended_correction: Run targeted runtime fixtures against the identity-bound game build and retain logs.
omissions.smallest_regression_test: Execute one minimal fixture for each unresolved require/bridge/event/UI surface and require affirmative markers.

cross_surface_findings.title: Update-safe gate mutates source and can report green without smoke/log success
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Step 3 invokes generate_smoke_pings.py without --dry-run; final success depends only on steps 1-3 while ping-run failure and log errors are informational.
missing_proof: Gate was not executed because product mutation was prohibited.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: Make the gate read-only by default, validate generated bytes in temp, and fail on required smoke/log evidence.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: Run against a copied tree with a failing ping command and an error log; assert nonzero and no source hash change.

cross_surface_findings.title: API verifier permits false confidence through skips, stale baselines, and weak comparison keys
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Current run has 56 SKIP and still exits 0; generated_at makes raw output nondeterministic; baseline comparison keys omit occurrence count/ownership. Checked inventory was generated 2026-04-08 against older layer hashes.
missing_proof: Unknown receiver semantics and dynamic calls remain unresolved.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: Make codebase root explicit, separate unknown budget, canonicalize timestamps, bind baselines to VERSION layer hashes, and compare ownership/count deltas.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: Inject a new skipped receiver and a moved same-status call; both must produce a non-green delta.

cross_surface_findings.title: Smoke generator and log checker cannot establish affirmative execution
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Fresh generator output equals source, but it creates every root chain and emits no [UT_SMOKE] success marker. Log checker requires error marker and UT path on the same line and returns 0 even for a synthetic detected error.
missing_proof: No live current log proves the generated calls ran.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: Emit start/per-call/completion markers, parse multiline stack records, and use a nonzero gate exit for errors/missing completion.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: Feed success, missing-completion, split-line stack, and explicit-error logs and assert distinct nonzero outcomes.

cross_surface_findings.title: deploy.sh targets obsolete 42 path and destructively replaces live content
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Script writes release/UniversalTraits/42/media while project contract requires 42.0, does not clear release extras, then rm -rf's the live target and has no verification.
missing_proof: Not executed due destructive scope.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: Retire or rewrite with 42.0, staged atomic copy, full parity verification, and explicit authorization.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: Deploy a fixture containing stale release/live extras and assert exact 42.0 parity without touching any real mod path.

cross_surface_findings.title: deploy.py --verify deploys first and verifies only source versus live media
reproduction_or_source_evidence: mirror() removes the destination; --verify is not read-only; verification omits release and mod.info. Invalid-mod negative fixture exits 1 before mutation.
missing_proof: No real deployment was authorized.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: Split read-only verify from deploy, stage atomically, and verify source/release/live media plus metadata.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: Corrupt only release and only mod.info in a temp fixture; read-only verify must fail and preserve all hashes.

cross_surface_findings.title: Current UniversalTraits release/live package is stale in four files
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Independent full-tree parity: equal path sets, four SHA mismatches; mod.info hashes are equal at source/release/live. UT_CORE is fully equal.
missing_proof: No deploy authority.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: After source tests and deploy-helper correction, update release/live through the authorized workflow.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: Exact path-set and SHA parity gate across all three copies.

cross_surface_findings.title: Profiler log helper crashes on Windows cp1252 output
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Temp ingest of 18,625-line console log succeeds for stats; profiler exits 1 with UnicodeEncodeError for U+2192 at line 432 under cp1252.
missing_proof: Other console encodings were not exhaustively tested.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: Use ASCII-safe output or explicitly configured UTF-8 with error handling; add a read-only database mode.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: Run profiler under cp1252 on a one-session fixture and require exit 0.

cross_surface_findings.title: Maintenance/fix scripts are broad relative-path mutators without transaction or idempotence contracts
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Source review found direct write_text/Set-Content operations and cwd-relative targeting; no dry-run/backup/expected-hash guards.
missing_proof: They were not executed against product state.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: Constrain each to explicit input/output, precondition hashes, temp staging, and deterministic dry-run.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: Run twice on a disposable fixture; second run must be byte-identical and out-of-root paths must be rejected.

cross_surface_findings.title: Campaign maps not-applicable without missing proof to proven-correct
reproduction_or_source_evidence: normalize_state returns proven-correct for not_applicable when missing_proof is empty; tests explicitly lock that behavior.
missing_proof: No explicit user-approved non-goal terminal state or per-dimension applicability proof exists.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: Represent non-goal/applicability separately; never infer positive proof from empty missing_proof.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: A not-applicable dimension without applicability evidence must fail validation or remain runtime-unproven.

cross_surface_findings.title: Campaign independent-review schema does not validate confidence, review-state, or ID references
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Severity and normalized finding state are checked, but confidence is copied verbatim, review_state is counted verbatim, and cross/verified/rejected/runtime-proof ID arrays are not resolved to declared IDs.
missing_proof: Current validator green does not prove those relationships.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: Define vocabularies and referential integrity for every ID-bearing field.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: Inject invalid confidence/review_state and dangling IDs; validator must exit nonzero.

cross_surface_findings.title: Recurring-pattern heuristics can overstate event/time defects
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Fractional thresholds are flagged by file co-occurrence with getTimeOfDay rather than dataflow; event registry derives only literal AddEvent names.
missing_proof: Dynamic/custom event production and threshold dataflow are unmodeled.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: Add dataflow-bounded checks or mark heuristic candidates runtime-unproven until source-linked.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: Fixture an unrelated 0.25 constant and a custom registered event; neither should be a confirmed defect.

cross_surface_findings.title: No CI configuration closes the local pass/fail surface
anchors: UTMods repository root (no .github workflow, YAML CI, or equivalent discovered)
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Closed-world inventory found no CI/config runner beyond AGENTS.md and local scripts.
missing_proof: Local commands can be skipped by release operators.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: Add a deterministic CI entrypoint for Lua suites, campaign tests/validator, API verification with unknown budget, and read-only package parity.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: Fresh checkout CI must fail on one injected test failure, skipped-API budget increase, and package mismatch.

cross_surface_findings.title: Passing standard-Lua mocks do not establish PZ/Kahlua semantics
reproduction_or_source_evidence: Current suites pass 218/0 and 374/0, but run under standalone Lua with mocked Java/PZ APIs.
missing_proof: 0-based Java collections, overload selection, callback timing, and UI propagation require live or closer-fidelity evidence.
cross_surface_findings.recommended_correction: Keep off-game tests but add targeted Kahlua/live contracts for changed semantic surfaces.
cross_surface_findings.smallest_regression_test: Run a small in-game fixture that exercises ArrayList indexing, overload selection, event arguments, and completion markers.
